data_source.name: 漁農自然護理署「野豬滋擾」網頁公佈之野豬捕捉行動紀錄
data_source.name_en: Wild boar capture-action records published on the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) "Wild Pig Nuisance" webpage
data_source.publisher: 香港特別行政區政府漁農自然護理署
data_source.publisher_en: Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, The Government of the Hong Kong SAR
data_source.processing: 本網站資料整理自政府公開發佈的捕捉行動資訊，並以地圖及圖表形式呈現，方便公眾查閱。
data_source.processing_en: The information on this website is compiled from publicly available government data and presented in a map-based visualisation for easier public reference.

coverage.note: 本網站收錄官方網頁現時逐項公佈的行動紀錄；官方網頁僅逐項列出最近期的行動，更早的行動只有匯總數字。因此本網站並非完整的歷史資料庫，不同時段之間可能存在空檔。
coverage.note_en: This website includes the itemised action records currently published on the official webpage; the official webpage only lists recent actions item by item, while earlier actions are published as totals only. The website is therefore not a complete historical database and there may be gaps between periods.

community_source.label: 公眾報告
community_source.note: 公眾可透過網站內的表單提交野豬出沒報告；報告未經官方核實，地圖上會以不同標示區分。
community_source.note_en: Visitors can submit wild boar sighting reports through the form on this website. Reports are not officially verified and are visually distinguished on the map.

activity_levels.label: 高活動
activity_levels.description: 最近 30 天內曾有行動紀錄

activity_levels.label: 中度活動
activity_levels.description: 最近 31–90 天內曾有行動紀錄

activity_levels.label: 低度活動
activity_levels.description: 最近 91–180 天內曾有行動紀錄

activity_levels.label: 較早紀錄
activity_levels.description: 最近一次行動已超過 180 天
activity_levels.description_en: Last capture more than 180 days ago

limitations: 本站主要資料為漁護署公佈的「野豬捕捉行動」紀錄，並非全港野豬數量普查；站內同時包含公眾提交的目擊報告，該等報告未經官方核實，僅供參考。
官方網頁只逐項公佈最近期的行動，較早行動僅有匯總數字，故本網站的時間序列不連續。
地點位置由地點名稱推算，屬近似位置，不代表實際行動或目擊的精確地點。
活動指標只反映「紀錄時間新近度」，並非風險預測，亦不代表某地點現時是否危險。
資料會定期與官方公佈及公眾報告同步（現時每月一次），並非即時資料。
limitations_en: The primary data are AFCD capture-action records, not a territory-wide wild boar population survey. The site also includes community-submitted sighting reports, which are not officially verified and are provided for reference only.
The official webpage itemises only recent actions; earlier actions are published as totals only, so the time series on this website is not continuous.
Locations are estimated from place names and are approximate; they do not represent the exact spot of each operation or sighting.
The activity indicator only reflects how recent the records are. It is not a risk forecast and does not indicate whether a location is currently dangerous.
The data are synced periodically with official publications and community reports (currently monthly), not in real time.
